progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gb3 and dwells most on B in Kereshme. Avaz (0:10.3) introduces Db, Ds, Eb, E, centred on B. The line peaks at E4 (316.9 Hz) at 0:18.0. It closes on the tonic (B3 → B3 → B2 → B3 → B3 → B3).
